name: lastping
description: LastPing alerts you when your AI agents fail, stall, wait for your approval or never start, and watches the cron jobs and CI/CD pipelines around them. Free for individuals.
long_description:
LastPing alerts you when your AI agents fail, stall, wait for your approval or never start, and watches the cron jobs and CI/CD pipelines around them. Free for individuals.

From Claude you can set up monitoring for what you actually run: Claude Code and other agents, scheduled AI tasks, n8n, Zapier and Make automations, cron jobs and CI workflows. Claude creates the monitors, tells you exactly what to add for each one, and reads incidents back to you. Underneath it is a dead man's switch: each job checks in, and LastPing alerts you when a check-in stops arriving.

This extension runs the LastPing MCP server on your computer. It carries the tool set of the release it was built from, and calls the LastPing API with the key you enter at install. Claude Desktop keeps that key in your system keychain.

api_key.title: LastPing API key
api_key.description: A write-scope key from Settings, API keys. It is stored in your system keychain.
